title: Match capitals: Latin America and the Caribbean
intro: Match each country in Latin America and the Caribbean with its capital city.

pairs.explain: Santo Domingo is the capital of Dominican Republic.
Quito is the capital of Ecuador.
Tegucigalpa is the capital of Honduras.
Castries is the capital of Saint Lucia.
Mexico City is the capital of Mexico.
Panama City is the capital of Panama.
Montevideo is the capital of Uruguay.
Caracas is the capital of Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of).
